schema_note: Enriched retrodiction card: original candidate card + audit + skeptic panel + repair-agent output (narrowed claim, lemma sequence, scores, triage). Produced 2026-06-02 by the Repair Agent + Fertility Judge for R017. All paper citations verified against the frozen corpus at /home/repos/six-birds-papers.

original_card.one_sentence_claim: In a weakly-coupled metastable Markov substrate with a basin lens, SBT's empirical packaging operator E_{tau,f} exhibits a sharp three-regime structure -- multiple coexisting epsilon-stable basin-prototype objects at intermediate tau, drift at leakage timescales, and collapse to a single trivial object at long tau -- and the no-go NG_OBJECT_CONTRACTIVE proves that such multiplicity is possible ONLY outside the strict-contraction (fast-global-mixing) regime (TV<=2eps/(1-lambda); unique object at eps=0), recovering the standard Kemeny-Snell/Perron-cluster metastable-lumping and Dobrushin-uniqueness picture as an objecthood-stability statement.
original_card.target_known_fact: Physical systems exhibit multiple long-lived, well-separated classical configurations (metastable phases, basins, quasi-conserved sectors) coexisting at intermediate timescales, which merge into a single equilibrium description at long times; coexistence requires absence of fast global mixing. Standard account: Kemeny-Snell exact/approximate lumpability, Perron-cluster (PCCA) metastable decomposition tied to the slow part of the spectrum, and Dobrushin uniqueness for strictly contracting chains.
original_card.scientific_domain: Statistical mechanics / metastability / Markov-chain sector structure (finite-state)
original_card.minimum_viable_result: A single worked finite example (extending EXP-MK1 to m>=2 basins) plus a short corollary chain: (i) T-IC-02 certifies >=2 epsilon-stable prototypes at intermediate tau (coexistence, satisfying the D-IC-02 nontriviality guardrail), (ii) NG_OBJECT_CONTRACTIVE certifies a unique object once lambda(Phat_tau) is small (collapse), and (iii) the contrapositive states that coexistence requires non-contraction.
original_card.stronger_result: Add the spectral-gap <-> retention-error <-> lambda(Phat_tau) <-> Perron-cluster-count lemma to make the SBT epsilon-stable-prototype count provably coincide with the standard PCCA metastable-set count in the spectral-gap regime; optionally Lean-certify the full separation bound 2eps/(1-lambda).
original_card.fallback_result: SBT reproduces the ARCHITECTURE 'several distinct stable macro-objects coexist iff the dynamics is not globally contracting at that scale' as an exact corollary of NG_OBJECT_CONTRACTIVE plus T-IC-02, in a single m>=2-basin numerical example, framed as a recovery/reorganization of Dobrushin uniqueness and metastable lumping.
original_card.honest_status_note: Derivability class B (structural recovery/reorganization). Three honest gaps flagged by the original card: (1) no in-corpus worked example certifies >=2 distinct epsilon-stable prototypes as coexisting; (2) the spectral-gap<->lambda<->PCCA chain is UNPROVED; (3) the sector COUNT and identity are inputs, never SBT outputs (T-IC-01 makes the count lens/tau/epsilon-relative).

audit_summary.audit_verdict: STRUCTURAL RECOVERY, NOT A PREDICTION -- honestly flagged, high flexibility on the non-load-bearing (sector-count) axis. The genuinely rigid, reusable content is NG_OBJECT_CONTRACTIVE (TV<=2eps/(1-lambda); unique at eps=0) plus its contrapositive 'coexisting well-separated objects force non-contraction', but this is logically equivalent to imported Dobrushin uniqueness (Dobrushin1956, Seneta2006) and Kemeny-Snell lumpability, NOT a novel prediction. SBT does NOT predict the number or identity of sectors (lens + declared-substrate inputs; T-IC-01 makes the count lens/tau/epsilon-relative). ~8 DoF vs ~4 qualitative/architectural data points. The contraction=>uniqueness direction is rigid and cannot be flipped; the sector count is fully tunable via lens/substrate. Mechanism reused with R016 (uniqueness-necessity) and R001/R029/R030 (idempotent packaging E_{tau,f}), mitigating one-off-fit concern. Recommend acceptance ONLY as class-B recovery with multiplicity-count demoted to lens-relative and the PCCA match labeled aspirational/unproved.
key_audit_findings: Q1 (post-hoc construction): PARTLY. The core inequality is a general Dobrushin theorem proved independently; but the 'metastable substrate with basin lens' framing and the EXP-MK1 demonstration were explicitly constructed to land on known metastability phenomenology.

Q3 (imports vs derives): YES, heavily. Dobrushin contraction => unique stationary + geometric convergence is imported; Kemeny-Snell and PCCA imported wholesale. Ledger itself labels NG_OBJECT_CONTRACTIVE 'consistent recovery of a standard contraction result ... not a physics retrodiction.'

Q5 (predicts count?): NO. Sector count m and basin identity are inputs; T-IC-01 makes the count lens/tau/epsilon-relative. On the predictive axis SBT is strictly weaker than PCCA, which reads cluster count off the spectrum.

Q6 (disclaimers honored?): YES, and the card is unusually candid -- finite-state only, lens-relative, Phat_tau treated as diagnostic (CD_tau>0), prototype non-canonicity flagged. Any 'objective physical sectors' upgrade would cross the no-canonical-lens / no-pointer-selection disclaimers.

skeptic_panel_summary.shared_main_objection: All four skeptics independently identify the SAME load-bearing flaw: NG_OBJECT_CONTRACTIVE is stated for the one-step macro self-map nu->nuP on Delta(Y) with eps-stability TV(nu,nuP)<=eps, whereas the R1 'coexistence' objects are epsilon-stable prototypes of the DIFFERENT packaging endomap E_{tau,f} on Delta(Z) (s_{tau,f}(x)=TV(E_{tau,f}(u_x),u_x)), and the macro kernel Phat_tau=U_f P^tau Q_f is a THIRD object. Gluing the R1-coexistence half (T-IC-02) to the R3-collapse half (NG_OBJECT_CONTRACTIVE) requires the spectral-gap<->retention<->lambda(Phat_tau)<->PCCA-count bridge lemma, which the card itself flags as the only hard lemma and as UNPROVED. Without it, R017 is two separately-true facts spliced by an asserted, not derived, correspondence.
secondary_objections: The in-corpus demonstration does NOT show coexistence: Quantum sec:markov is titled 'Two regimes', plots only the scalar delta(tau) for a SINGLE fixed partition, and reports MKFirstStableTau=1 (stable already at tau=1, no demonstrated intermediate window). D-IC-02 explicitly says small delta cannot certify multiplicity. No experiment in the corpus reports >=2 distinct epsilon-stable prototypes.

The PCCA / Kemeny-Snell quantitative match is vapor: corpus-wide grep finds PCCA/Perron-cluster exactly ONCE, as a literature citation (DeuflhardWeber2005) in the No-Go related-work, never as derived machinery. The 'data_matched' PCCA-count claim has zero supporting mechanism.

Applying a contraction theorem to Phat_tau, a kernel the theory itself says is NOT closed (CD_tau>0, NG_MACRO_CLOSURE_DEFICIT), is adjacent to the forbidden move 'claiming a closed macro law when CD_tau>0'; the R3 collapse must be stated conditionally.

The contrapositive 'coexistence forces non-contraction' is near-tautological: R1 coexistence requires basin mass to stay put, i.e. Phat_tau approximately equals identity, hence lambda approximately 1; this is definitional, not a physical prediction.
Sector count is an INPUT not a prediction; T-IC-01 makes it lens/tau/epsilon-relative (refinement reveals OR destroys objects). On the very axis where PCCA predicts, SBT only accommodates.
shared_minimum_acceptance_conditions: Demote every multiplicity statement to explicitly lens/tau/epsilon-relative; never assert objective physical sector counts.
Label the quantitative PCCA / Kemeny-Snell match as ASPIRATIONAL and UNPROVED; ship only the structural recovery plus the one contrapositive inequality.

State and prove the E_{tau,f}-prototype-stability => macro-kernel-near-identity bridge, OR restate the whole claim purely on the macro self-map nu->nu Phat_tau so NG_OBJECT_CONTRACTIVE applies without an unproved correspondence.

Exhibit at least one worked finite m>=2-basin example certifying >=2 distinct epsilon-stable prototypes coexisting at an intermediate tau (tau_first_stable>1), reporting count(tau), delta(tau), and lambda(Phat_tau), per the D-IC-02 nontriviality guardrail.

Frame as class-B recovery/reorganization of Dobrushin uniqueness + metastable lumping; concede it does NOT beat or predict beyond the standard account and does NOT predict the number/identity of sectors.
Carry the CD_tau>0 caveat into every contraction verdict; state R3 collapse only conditionally.

repair.post_repair_logical_status: After repair, R017 reduces to: (A) an elementary, true, lens-relative coexistence statement (T-IC-02 bounds prototype stability by retention error; in a leakage regime tau << tau_leak with retention error < epsilon for each basin, all m basin prototypes are epsilon-stable, giving >=2 distinct stable labels -- this assembly is new but trivial and is NOT yet exhibited in any worked m>=2 example in the corpus), and (B) the imported Dobrushin-uniqueness inequality NG_OBJECT_CONTRACTIVE on the macro self-map, with its contrapositive. The bridge tying (A) and (B) into one coherent 'three-regime' object is the conjectured, unproved hard lemma. The surviving rigid content is exactly one inequality (2eps/(1-lambda), paper-proof only, not formalized) that is logically equivalent to a 1956 result.
repair.minimum_viable_result_after_repair: A worked finite m>=2-basin chain with a genuine timescale gap (tau_first_stable>1) reporting, per tau, (i) the COUNT of epsilon-stable prototypes under E_{tau,f} (>=2 in the intermediate window, satisfying the D-IC-02 nontriviality clause), (ii) delta(tau), and (iii) lambda(Phat_tau) on the macro self-map -- presented as TWO separately-labeled statements (lens-relative coexistence; conditional contraction-uniqueness) explicitly framed as a class-B recovery of Dobrushin uniqueness + Kemeny-Snell lumpability, with the PCCA-count coincidence labeled an open conjecture. No new hard lemma; everything is reassembled already-proved SBT machinery, but the worked coexistence example (currently absent from the corpus) must actually be produced.
remaining_objections_after_repair: Even after splitting, the two halves concern different operators (E_{tau,f} on Delta(Z) vs nu->nu Phat_tau on Delta(X)); without the proved bridge lemma the 'single sharp three-regime structure' headline cannot be honestly retained, only a two-statement pairing.
The one rigid inequality is logically equivalent to imported Dobrushin uniqueness; novelty is presentational, not predictive (is_actually_new = false; beats_baseline = false).
SBT still cannot predict the sector count -- the thing PCCA actually predicts -- so the 'recovery' is strictly partial on the predictive axis.
The headline coexistence worked example with tau_first_stable>1 and >=2 certified stable prototypes does not yet exist in the corpus; until produced, the central novel reassembly is aspirational.
The PCCA / spectral-gap quantitative match remains entirely unproved (zero corpus machinery); only a qualitative numerical overlay is achievable in the near term.

score_rationale.impact: 2/5. The reusable inequality (contraction=>uniqueness with a 2eps/(1-lambda) addendum) is a clean finitely-checkable necessary condition, genuinely reusable across the SBT no-go layer (shared with R016). But it is logically equivalent to a 1956 textbook result and SBT cannot predict the sector count, so the marginal scientific impact over the standard Dobrushin/Kemeny-Snell/PCCA toolkit is low.
score_rationale.execution_ease: 4/5. All core lemmas (NG_OBJECT_CONTRACTIVE, T-IC-02, T-IC-01, D-IC-02) are already proved; the EXP-MK1 numerical harness exists and need only be extended to m>=2 basins; the new corollaries are elementary. The only hard piece (the spectral-gap<->PCCA bridge) is explicitly deferred to the stronger result. Minimum-viable artifact is low-cost.
score_rationale.plausibility: 4/5. The post-repair statements are almost certainly true: T-IC-02 prototype-stability bound is proved; Dobrushin uniqueness is a theorem; the lens-relative coexistence in a leakage regime follows from the 1-(1-p)^tau mechanism. The only plausibility risk is the unproved bridge lemma, which is excluded from the minimum-viable claim.
score_rationale.non_ad_hocness: 3/5. The underlying inequality is principled and was proved independently of metastability (not post-hoc). But the substrate+lens framing is engineered to land on known phenomenology, the sector structure is essentially declared (smuggling-adjacent per the card's own bottleneck), and ~8 DoF >> ~4 qualitative data points. Honest disclaimers and the D-IC-02 guardrail pull this up from a 2.
score_rationale.discriminative_power: 1/5. The opposite-world test is decisive: the contraction=>uniqueness direction is rigid and cannot be flipped (good), but the sector COUNT -- the empirically interesting quantity -- is fully tunable via lens/substrate choice, so SBT can accommodate essentially any observed count, including the opposite of what physics shows. It does not discriminate between worlds with different sector structure.
score_rationale.audience_legibility: 4/5. The framing (objecthood = fixed points of a packaging endomap; coexistence iff non-contraction) is clear and legible to Markov-chain/metastability theorists and coarse-graining modelers. The honest separation of theorem-content from input-content is exactly the kind of audit those audiences value. Docked one point because the operator mismatch (E_{tau,f} vs Phat_tau vs nu->nuP) is a genuine legibility trap that the original card obscured.
score_rationale.precision: 2/5. The single rigid quantitative statement (TV<=2eps/(1-lambda)) is precise, but it is only paper-proof (not formalized) and is a relabeled import. The headline 'three-regime' object lacks a precise unifying definition across the two operators. SBT's no-output-on-count and no-canonical-lens disclaimers cap precision: the theory produces no sharp numeric prediction of any observable here.
score_rationale.robustness: 3/5. The contraction-uniqueness direction is robust (a theorem). The coexistence side is robust qualitatively but the certified count shifts with epsilon and lens (T-IC-01), and lambda(Phat_tau) is prototype-dependent on a non-closed (CD_tau>0) macro kernel. Robust as an architecture, fragile as a count.
score_rationale.baseline_advantage: 1/5. The card itself concedes 'SBT does NOT beat the standard account; it RECOVERS and reorganizes it.' On the predictive axis (sector count from spectrum) it is strictly weaker than PCCA. The only edge is conceptual organization / honesty audit, not predictive advantage.
score_rationale.publication_potential: 2/5. Publishable only as an honest class-B recovery / conceptual-reframing note within the SBT program or a methods-oriented venue, contingent on producing the missing m>=2 worked example and demoting the PCCA claim to a conjecture. Not publishable as a novel metastability result to a stat-mech audience, since it imports and relabels rather than derives. The unproved bridge lemma is the only path to higher potential and is genuine new mathematics.

recommended_artifact: A short worked-example note plus a reproducible numerical experiment: extend EXP-MK1 to an m>=2-basin chain with a genuine timescale gap (tau_first_stable>1); report, per tau, the COUNT of epsilon-stable E_{tau,f}-prototypes (>=2 in the intermediate window, honoring the D-IC-02 nontriviality clause), delta(tau), and lambda(Phat_tau) on the macro self-map nu->nu Phat_tau; overlay against a PCCA/spectral-gap decomposition of the same kernel as a QUALITATIVE comparison only. Accompany with two separately-labeled corollaries (lens-relative coexistence via T-IC-02; conditional contraction-uniqueness via NG_OBJECT_CONTRACTIVE) and an explicit statement of the open bridge lemma. Frame strictly as a class-B recovery of Dobrushin uniqueness + Kemeny-Snell lumpability. Lean adds value only for the 2eps/(1-lambda) separation bound and is optional.
one_line_verdict: Honest class-B structural recovery of Dobrushin uniqueness + metastable lumping carrying exactly one reusable (but imported-equivalent) inequality; the 'sharp three-regime' headline splices two different operators across an unproved bridge, SBT cannot predict the sector count, and the coexistence worked example does not yet exist -- repairable to a clean conceptual-reframing note, but not a novel prediction.
